title: Un'Goro Crater
body: Un'Goro Crater is a vast sunken jungle in southern Kalimdor, ringed by cliffs, where steam rises from the pools and the volcano of Fire Plume Ridge still smolders at its heart. Visitors say entering it is like stepping into another world: it seems untouched by outside hands, and its creatures are nobler, mightier kin of beasts known elsewhere, devilsaurs, stegodons and great apes. Colored power crystals glitter across the basin, crystal pylons of legend stand in remote corners, and in the south the Gorishi silithid have dug a hive.

parts.body: On the northern bluffs stand a great stone terrace and a waygate of the titans that joins the crater to Sholazar Basin in Northrend, and cultists of the Scourge hold them.

title: Marshal's Refuge
body: Marshal's Refuge is a camp on high ground at the crater's northern edge, where Marshal Expeditions, a troupe of explorers aligned with no faction, fled when the beasts overran their base camps on what was meant to be their greatest venture. The refuge is now a home for the lost and stranded: a gnome with no memory, two travelers who will not speak to each other, and J.D. Collie, who studies the crater's crystals in a cave nearby.

parts.body: Once the three great pylons are found, J.D. works out their secret: each fuses two colors of the crater's crystals into a single charm.

title: Fire Plume Ridge
body: Fire Plume Ridge is the smoldering volcano at the heart of the crater, its slopes walked by living blazes and its summit lava said to be hot enough to fuse thorium and bone. On the ridge dwells Blazerunner, a great fire elemental wrapped in an aura that, the refuge's residents say, no one has ever broken; many who tried were thrown from the rocky paths.

parts.body: The amnesiac gnome Linken came to Un'Goro to fight Blazerunner. In a cave on the ridge the elemental keeps the Golden Flame, a relic of vast power, and drew his aura from it.

title: The Slithering Scar
body: The Slithering Scar is a great silithid hive gouged into the south of the crater, home of the insects called the Gorishi, with larval hatcheries hung with dangling spawn deep inside. The expedition's biologist finds the Gorishi entirely alien to the crater's ecology, and scholars in Darnassus and Orgrimmar wonder whether the silithid draw their strength from Un'Goro itself.

parts.body: With its queen slain, Gadgetzan's alchemist is surer than ever that the silithid answer to a malign intelligence, and he warns that so clean a victory cannot be the end of them.

title: The Shaper's Terrace
body: High on the bluffs above Marshal's Refuge lies the Shaper's Terrace, a great expanse of titan stonework beside a waygate that joins Un'Goro to Sholazar Basin in Northrend. On it looms the Etymidian, a stone colossus of the titans, silent and inert, with an empty rune-shaped slot in its chest, and acolytes of the Cult of the Damned have taken the terrace.

parts.body: Their leader curses those who come for him: they have found the only being that could stand against the Scourge, and they will never bring it back to Northrend.
sources: zone_areas area 4382: Death's Hand Acolyte 28602 x10, The Etymidian 28092; area 4381 Waygate

parts.body: With the Omega Rune set in its chest the colossus wakes: activation successful. Whatever it was woken for lies beyond the waygate.
